plainText:
Saki Fujita (Japanese: 藤田咲 Fujita Saki) is a Japanese voice actress for and .

==Biography==
Fujita was born on October 19, 1984, in , , and became a voice actress and singer as an adult. Fujita provided her voice for Anthea, one of 's foster sisters, in . She then provided her voice for Lyn, a character of the day who appeared in . Later in , her role was Pikala. Fujita was affiliated with the talent agency .
